proposedRinkuScene.title: The Repair Was Finished; the Question Wasn't
proposedRinkuScene.coreReason: One overdue replacement water-filter coupler after Jan2 promised follow-up. The replacement and safe pressure check are completed first, then an optional personal conversation chosen by both adults.
proposedRinkuScene.outfitContinuity: After Wednesday work-demo guests leave ~20:15–20:35, Ankita changes for a comfortable home evening into a distinct deep-teal casual wrap kurta and trousers. She chooses to look attractive, but this is not John/Dhika's rejected skirt, not Friday's wet nightdress and not a new exposure accident.

beats.action: Rinku arrives through regular late service-access route with the exact matching coupler. Ankita opens the ticket, jokes that he has taken five days to remember her water filter. He apologizes for stock delay and failing to update her Friday as promised.

He installs and tests the connector safely and signs the receipt. Ankita knows he is there to complete an actual duty; no touching becomes an entitlement of the repair visit. Their returning easy banter is different from Friday's visible self-consciousness.

He heads toward the normal tower exit. Ankita voluntarily accompanies him down for some fresh air after long office/team activity. They keep their conversation in the covered courtyard path rather than relying on every family member magically vanishing from the kitchen.

She reveals that on Jan2 she had deliberately tested whether he noticed her. He admits his silence meant he was attracted and uncertain whether she wanted him to say anything. He offers his own small honest answer—not fabricated bereavement or life crisis. She responds by asking him to speak to her as a person rather than only a service worker.

Their teasing pauses into a mutually chosen closeness. Ankita touches his hand of her own choice; he first gives her space to change her mind. They explicitly welcome a first brief kiss, SELECTED OUTCOME. It is neither a replay of DHIKA ice-cream finger incident nor a sudden involuntary kiss.

His first reaction is disbelief followed by a shy smile and direct check that she is comfortable. Ankita's second kiss of the evening changes her own assessment of what she is doing. Rinku takes a normal exit; returning to Kabir and the brothers brings genuine secrecy/relationship conflict, with no invented confession or witness.

sampleLines: Ankita: 'Rinku, connector itna rare tha ya tumhari Friday wali khamoshi?'
Rinku: 'Part nahi mila tha. Update na karna meri galti thi... aur us din ki baat bhi yaad thi.'
Ankita: 'Achha? Toh jo main jaanbujhkar kar rahi thi, usko tumne kya samjha?'
Rinku: 'Maine samjha shayad aap chahti thi main notice karun. Lekin main assume nahi karna chahta tha.'
Ankita: 'Ab main tumse seedha poochh rahi hoon. Mujhe dekhkar tum kya feel karte ho?'
